''See also: [[dream madra Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Dream [[madra]] is a specific type of spiritual energy characterized by its purple, pink, or violet coloration. It often manifests with a hazy, illusory light and can appear as shifting, folding networks of light or as wisps and shapes. In terms of physical sensation, it is described as feeling squishy and insubstantial, similar to the nature of dream spirits. This [[madra]] is used to create various [[constructs]], such as flickering butterflies or illusory clones, and can be utilized in dream binding{{!}}bindings. It is also associated with the [[Dreamway]], a massive [[library]] of knowledge located within [[dreams]], and has been used to assault or influence minds. Furthermore, dream [[madra]] can be found in certain artifacts like [[dream tablets]] and [[scales]], and it is linked to the power of the [[Silent King]], who can use a combination of dream and [[hunger madra]] to siphon [[aura]] from hosts.}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The [[Silent King]] is known to possess dream [[madra]]. While certain images within a room may be mistaken for it, [[Dross]] has noted that such visual phenomena are not actually dream [[madra]]. This substance, along with [[aura]], possesses the capability to assault the minds of others. Throughout various encounters, both [[Lindon]] and [[Dross]] have utilized dream [[madra]].}}
